objective: Build the Diwali runway and sell the biggest tickets of the year (6 Months and privates) before the festival season, when clients commit for the season rather than the month.
strategy:
57 Days to Diwali.

Commercial job: Build the Diwali runway and sell the biggest tickets of the year (6 Months and privates) before the festival season, when clients commit for the season rather than the month.

Newcomer: The 57-Day Proof (“57 days. Then you'll know.”). A 57-day runway is the story of the quarter; a 3-month entry attaches newcomers to the whole festive season instead of a week.

Newcomer: Private Matters (“Your first private, 25% off. Your first month, 20% off.”). Biggest ticket, best retention, and privates are capacity we already have.

Winback: The Return Policy (“No penalties for the year you took off. Come back at 20%.”). Festival season is the natural moment for a reset, and the framing removes the guilt of the gap.

Renewal: Festive Pause Button (“Freeze for the festivals. Pay for the season.”). Clients won't train Diwali week; selling 3 Months with freezes protects the renewal and the ticket.

Renewal: Private Matters (renewal) — for existing 3M+ members, a private pack at 20% off keeps them in and lifts the ticket.
notes:
Moment: Diwali runway: 57 days to Diwali (29 Oct 2027) with a weekly countdown, a 'Festive Pause' plan for members travelling, and the Navratri / Durga Puja class window (28 Sep–1 Oct).
Build: new clients ₹6.2L (10 on the 3-month entry at ₹46,284); reactivation 38 × ₹11,468 = ₹4.3L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.0L; renewals ₹26.0L. First visits needed 179; CRM leads needed 223.

items.detail: Set up The 57-Day Proof in Momence (1 Sep–15 Oct.): 3 Months Unlimited at 20% off (₹46,284) — 57 classes in 57 days unlocks 2 bonus privates and Diwali-week priority booking.
Set up Private Matters in Momence (All Sept.): Your first 30-min private at 25% off (₹2,500) and 1 Month Unlimited at 20% off (₹16,191).
Set up The Return Policy in Momence (All Sept.): 1 Month Unlimited at 20% off (₹16,191) or a 12-class pack at 20% off (₹15,750) — a written 'return policy' that waives any admin fee.
Set up Festive Pause Button in Momence (All Sept.): 3 Months Unlimited at 15% off (₹49,177) — freezes around Diwali with no limit.
Brief the team on the 4 September offers, who each one is for, and the no-stacking rule; print the offer cards for the desk.
Launch The 57-Day Proof to First-time clients.
Launch Private Matters to First-time clients wanting 1:1.
Launch The Return Policy to Lapsed clients.
Launch Festive Pause Button to Members renewing in September.
Run the month's moment: Diwali runway: 57 days to Diwali with a weekly countdown, a 'Festive Pause' plan for members travelling, and Navratri / Durga Puja class window (28 Sep–1 Oct).

Weekly check: The 57-Day Proof: 57-day entries; finish rate. | Private Matters: Privates sold; first-month conversion. | The Return Policy: Lapsed messages; purchases. | Festive Pause Button: 3M renewals; freezes. | Private Pack Renewal: Pack sales.
Mid-month review against ₹39.5L: by the 15th aim for about half of 260 renewals, 40 reactivations and 48 new buyers (146 first visits). Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
Close September: tag every redemption by offer, record results, and brief October's offers.
